title: Complete Wine Girl Magnetic Bookmark Printable Collection, 20 Designs, 2x6 Inch PNG, Wine Lover Gift, Digital Download
description:
The complete collection: ALL 20 wine-lover magnetic bookmark designs in one instant download, ready to print at home or at a print shop. Stylish women enjoying a glass of wine, each with a wine-themed journaling quote on the back panel. Print, cut, fold, and add magnets for bookmarks, wine journal accessories, party favors, or gifts.

✦ BEST VALUE
Includes all four of our 5-design wine bookmark bundles: Bundle 1 (Designs 01–05), Bundle 2 (Designs 06–10), Bundle 3 (Designs 11–15), Bundle 4 (Designs 16–20). Buying the four bundles separately is $19.96; the complete 20-design collection is $12.99.

✦ WHAT YOU GET
• 20 PNG designs delivered as 5 ZIP files (4 designs per ZIP). Download all 5 ZIP files and unzip them; together they contain all 20 designs.
• Each design: 1200 x 3600 px, 600 PPI, 2 x 6 inches flat / 2 x 3 inches folded
• A short printing-instructions text file is included in each ZIP
• Instant digital download, no physical item shipped

✦ THE DESIGNS
Designs 01–20 feature a variety of wine-lover portraits and backdrops — florals, watercolors, marble, golden light, sunset skies, tropical blooms, city lights, and more. See the listing photos for every design.

✦ HOW TO USE
• Print at 100% / Actual Size (do not use "Fit to Page")
• Each bookmark prints flat at 2 x 6 inches and folds to 2 x 3 inches at the center bridge
• Cut around the bookmark outline, fold at the center, and add small magnets to the inside ends to make a magnetic bookmark (magnets, paper, and printer are not included)
• The upside-down quote on the back panel is intentional; it reads correctly once the bookmark is folded

✦ FILE DETAILS
• Format: PNG, RGB (sRGB color)
• Size: 1200 x 3600 px per design (2 x 6 inches at 600 PPI)
• The artwork is supplied on a solid black (white on Design 16) background outside the bookmark outline (no transparent background) — cut along the bookmark edge
• Original artwork files; the ZIP packaging (if any) does not compress or change the images

✦ INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD
Your files are available to download from Etsy immediately after payment is confirmed. This is a DIGITAL PRODUCT: no physical bookmark, magnets, or printed item will be shipped, and nothing is sent to you manually.

✦ AI DISCLOSURE
These designs were created with the assistance of AI image-generation tools as part of my creative process, then hand-curated, cleaned up, and prepared for print.

✦ USAGE
For personal use and small-batch commercial use on physical items you make and sell. Resale or redistribution of the digital files themselves is not permitted.

✦ PLEASE NOTE
Printed colors can vary by monitor, printer, ink, and paper. Preview images carry a watermark; the files you download do not.

Thank you for shopping Dragon Oak Studio!
